slo.description: Service Level Objectives for production monitoring

budgets.description: Monthly cost budgets with alert thresholds

webhooks.description: Webhook secret names for alert routing (values stored in secrets, never committed)

schedules.description: Cron schedules for agent runs (light: every 12h, heavy: weekly Monday 3:15 AM)

migration.description: Environment flag that must be set to true for migrations to run (safety guard)

admin.description: Secret name for Basic Auth credentials (format: username:password, base64 encoded)

telemetry.description: Feature flag to enable Expo TTI telemetry collection

regression.description: Number of consecutive cycles with regression before opening parent issue
